data.body:
Completion evidence for each Acceptance Criteria item:
- config.py 689 LOC, plan_review/__init__.py 606 LOC (both <=700) via extraction into config_readers.py (137 LOC) / plan_review/floors.py (222 LOC) only -- no other files touched for the split.
- Neither new module is <100 LOC; both are pure verbatim relocations (no mechanical split, no logic changes).
- Confirmed via held-out validation (145/148 passed pre-fix) and a live mutation/teeth check: temporarily dropped the config_readers re-export, confirmed test_model_classes.py's monkeypatch.setattr(rebar.llm.config, ...) tests failed for the right reason (AttributeError), then restored -- all green. Same held-out run proved every plan_review floor-helper monkeypatch seam (rising_floor, completion_floor, sidecar_heldout, blocking_fix_unit_grouping) still intercepts through __init__.py's namespace.
- test_env_registry_helper_coverage.py's _CONFIG_PY repointed to config_readers.py; test_subcall_class_selection.py's _EXPECTED_RUN_REQUEST_SITES entry updated to llm/plan_review/floors.py::_score_floor_novelty. Both files pass (18/18).
- floors.py's _score_floor_novelty / _classify_completion reach _verifier_cfg via a lazy in-function import (from rebar.llm.plan_review import _verifier_cfg); confirmed no circular import at collection time.
- Full default suite (make test): 18008 passed, 9 failed -- all 9 confirmed pre-existing via git stash against the unmodified tree (unrelated git-subprocess/env failures in test_atomic_completion_close.py / test_rebar_repo_isolation.py / test_tracker_footprint_cli.py). The one failure this change DID cause (test_gate_context_seam.py's no-repoint guard, which didn't yet know about the config_readers.py sibling) was fixed by extending its allowlist with a documented rationale (current_code_root() there is a ContextVar read, never a monkeypatch target) and reverified green.
- model_classes.py's _read_llm_file_table import verified unchanged and passing (test_model_classes.py, test_model_class_ladder.py green).
- llm/runner.py not touched (confirmed via git diff --stat on the landed change).
- make lint, make typecheck both clean; module-size gate (wc -l against .github/module-size-limit.txt=800) and complexity ratchet (scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check: active=39 new=0 increased=0) both pass. Also required a one-line fix to scripts/check_config_ownership.py's composition-root allowlist (config_readers.py wasn't recognized as config.py's sibling) and a docs/env-vars.md regen, both landed in the same change.

Landed as Gerrit change https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2390 (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, submitted/merged to main at commit 27cdc312846a).
